Portfolio statistics reflect accessible records across the workspace. Upcoming departures include future published tours only. Confirmed guest counts exclude draft and cancelled bookings. Package creation and editing are restricted to Tour Managers.
Average prices are calculated only when all packages share the same currency. Price sorting groups packages by currency without performing currency conversion.
